name: Evelynn
notes: Evelynn is assumed to begin the fight out of combat under Demon Shade, so her opening Whiplash cast is the empowered version; attacking or casting ends Demon Shade for the rest of the fight, so no later Whiplash cast is empowered.

Hate Spike's 3 free recasts are fired back to back every 0.5 s right after the initial dart, and its mark's 3 bonus-damage charges are modeled as always consumed by those 3 recasts (matching the wiki's stated total-damage formula for a full combo); basic attacks are not modeled as consuming the mark.

Allure deals no direct damage against a champion target (its bonus damage in the leveling table is monster-only, and the dummy counts as a champion). It is still cast on cooldown purely to reach the mark's 2.5 s maturity, which is modeled as automatically applying the magic resist shred 2.5 s after cast, since the engine has no generic 'next hit consumes a mark' hook; see `unused.W`.
The magic resist shred is declared under Q because the engine reads shred from a single fixed slot regardless of which ability applies it; see 'assumed' for the rank it uses.

Whiplash's damage is base plus a percentage of the TARGET's maximum health, and that percentage itself scales with Evelynn's AP per the numbers sheet's formula; the AP used is the build's static level-16 value, computed once. Its 25 minimum and 450 monster-only cap never bind against a champion-type target and are omitted.

Last Caress's 240% damage below 30% target health is modeled as a flat conditional multiplier, not a true critical strike, so it is unaffected by crit-damage items; the dossier flags this reading as unsettled and the other option (true crit) was not chosen.

Last Caress is cast the instant it is off cooldown; its cooldown vastly exceeds a single fight so normally only one cast lands, but the driver will fire a second if a build's ability haste brings it back up in time.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here plausibly empties Evelynn's level-16 mana pool within a 15 s fight.
Evelynn attacks normally between ability casts; her kit has no on-hit damage of its own tied to basic attacks, so a build's own on-hit/attack-speed items apply through the engine as usual.
Hate Spike's and Allure's disputed bin-vs-wiki cast times (0.25 s vs 0.3 s, 0.15 s vs 0.25 s) do not change the engine's fixed 0.25 s attack-lockout, so the discrepancy has no effect on the result.

assumed.why: Allure's magic resist shred scales 35-45% with its own rank, but the engine's shred slot reads a single flat number regardless of which ability applies it; the max-rank 45% value is used.

unused.W: Allure's leveling table gives it a bonus-magic-damage term only against monsters ('Monster Damage'/'MonsterDamageTotalTOOLTIP'); against the champion-type dummy the empowered consume applies only the magic resist shred (modeled under Q's shred slot) with no damage of its own, so W never appears as a damage source even though it is cast every time it is off cooldown.
